TX FIFO empty: stall,
everything holds

span.p:
RX FIFO full: stall,
everything holds

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PULL [p, l] [d]
shift_reg ← TX FIFO head
takes 1 + d cycles
after any stall

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PUSH [p, l] [d]
RX FIFO ← in_shift_reg
(register keeps its value)
takes 1 + d cycles
after any stall

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NOP [d]
nothing changes
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SET p, l [d]
gpio[p] ← l
other pins unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHIFT_OUT [p, l] [d]
gpio[0] ← next bit, then shift:
shift_dir 0: shift_reg[0], >> 1
shift_dir 1: shift_reg[7], << 1
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHIFT_IN i [p, l] [d]
bit = gpio_in[i] at cycle start
shift_dir 0: >> 1, then [7] ← bit
shift_dir 1: << 1, then [0] ← bit
(of in_shift_reg)
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CONFIG f, v [p, l] [d]
config[f] ← v
(f = 0: shift_dir)
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
WAIT i, v [p, l] [d]
stall while gpio_in[i] != v
(read at cycle start, like SHIFT_IN)
takes 1 + d cycles
after any stall

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
JMP target [d]
pins, registers unchanged
no side effect
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
side effect [p, l]
on every instruction but JMP:
gpio[p] ← l on the first cycle,
the same edge as the operation
(after any stall)
